Projects.hyprDesc: AI-powered performance review system for 1500+ employees. Automatic generation of structured feedback and objective scoring.
Projects.hyprProblem: Manual performance reviews took 3 weeks per cycle and suffered from significant subjective biases, reducing employee trust.
Projects.hyprResult2: Review time reduced from 3 weeks to 3 days
Projects.hyprResult3: Manager satisfaction score went from 62% to 91%
Projects.bigpictureDesc: Cross-platform initiative tracking synchronizing Jira, Confluence, and Google Sheets for real-time project progress visibility.
Projects.bigpictureProblem: Teams used 3 different tools with no consolidated view. Weekly status updates required 4 hours of manual work per PM.
Projects.caplabourDesc: Capacity planning tool (v1 + v2) enabling managers to forecast workload and optimize resource allocation.
Projects.caplabourProblem: Capacity planning was done in Excel with outdated data. Over-allocations were detected too late, causing project delays.
Projects.kindlyDesc: Compliance bot with automated monitoring. Smart reminders and real-time corrective action tracking.
Projects.kindlyProblem: Teams regularly forgot to complete compliance actions, leading to audit risks and time-consuming manual follow-ups.
Projects.n8nDesc: 18 enterprise automation workflows covering onboarding, reporting, alerting, and cross-system data synchronization.
Projects.n8nProblem: Dozens of repetitive manual processes between Slack, Jira, Google Workspace, and internal tools, generating errors and wasted time.
Projects.jiraDesc: 18 Jira Cloud rules automating ticket management: assignment, transitions, notifications, and SLA tracking.
Projects.jiraProblem: Manual Jira ticket management created status inconsistencies, forgotten assignments, and approximate SLA tracking.
Projects.catalogueDesc: Centralized registry of all organization automations with documentation, ownership, and performance metrics.
Projects.catalogueProblem: With 40+ automations in production, nobody knew exactly what existed, who was responsible, or if it was working correctly.
Projects.imocDesc: RAG-powered system that automatically generates structured incident post-mortems and vectorizes all JPROD incident data for instant retrieval.
Projects.imocProblem: Incident reviews required hours of manual work, resulting in inconsistent documentation, delayed learnings, and no searchable incident knowledge base.
Projects.imocResult1: Incident reviews generated in <5 min vs 2+ hours manually
Projects.imocResult2: All JPROD incidents automatically vectorized and searchable
Projects.imocResult3: Tool in daily production use by the incident management team
Projects.kallpaDesc: AI running coach SaaS generating personalized training plans using VDOT algorithm and Pfitzinger methods. Live at app.kallpa.run.
Projects.kallpaProblem: Runners had no affordable access to structured training plans adapted to their real level, race calendar, and weekly time constraints.
Projects.kallpaResult1: Full SaaS in production at app.kallpa.run
Projects.kallpaResult3: VDOT + Pfitzinger algorithm for race-specific periodization
Projects.jobhunterDesc: Semi-autonomous job search pipeline with AI-powered multi-bloc scoring. Scans Gmail, job boards, and LinkedIn to surface high-match opportunities.
Projects.jobhunterProblem: Job hunting is noisy and time-consuming. No tool matches opportunities against a nuanced personal profile across multiple dimensions.
Projects.jobhunterResult2: AI scoring across 6 dimensions with auto-match ≥80
Projects.jobhunterResult3: Pipeline actively used in real job search with measurable signal

Testimonials.title: Trusted by those
Testimonials.michalRole: Interim Head of Incident Management & AI Transformation Lead
Testimonials.michalQuote: Matthieu was a key member of our automation team and genuinely one of those people who just gets things done. He built out our N8N AI automation pipelines end to end — most notably the RAG-powered Incident Review Creator. Both tools are now part of how our team operates daily. Matthieu is sharp, self-directed, and has a real knack for translating messy operational problems into clean, scalable automations.
Testimonials.aniketQuote: Matthieu is a powerhouse of innovation. He spearheaded an automation initiative that completely streamlined our data processing pipeline, reducing manual processing time by over 40%. Beyond the technical toolkit, he has a natural gift for bridging the gap with non-technical stakeholders. Matthieu has my highest possible recommendation.
